Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 83: May 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #83 shipped to subscribers in April 2008 (bearing the cover date of May 2008 for Issue 83). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #83 delivered a spring lineup of high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom gamerpics, and media previews:

Turning Point: Fall of Liberty (alternate-history WWII first-person shooter)
Conflict: Denied Ops (co-op tactical first-person shooter)
Commanders: Attack of the Genos (Xbox Live Arcade turn-based strategy)
Poker Smash (Xbox Live Arcade action-puzzle card game)
Rocketmen: Axis of Evil (Xbox Live Arcade twin-stick arcade shooter)
Triggerheart Exelica (Xbox Live Arcade vertical shoot 'em up)
Bliss Island (Xbox Live Arcade casual arcade action)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable Portal gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i media previews and art galleries—featuring early coverage for Grand Theft Auto IV, Fallout 3, Far Cry 2, Soulcalibur IV, Just Cause 2, and Tiberium, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
